description: This file contains unit tests for the session tab registry module, including functions for tracking, untracking, closing, and counting session browser tabs, utilizing the Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for the session tab registry.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup function called before each test, resets tracked session browser tabs.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Teardown function called after each test, resets tracked session browser tabs.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for tracking, untracking, and closing browser tabs.

methods.name: __countTrackedSessionBrowserTabsForTests
methods.description: Counts the number of tracked browser tabs for testing purposes.

methods.name: __resetTrackedSessionBrowserTabsForTests
methods.description: Resets the internal tracking of session browser tabs.

methods.name: closeTrackedBrowserTabsForSessions
methods.description: Closes browser tabs associated with given session keys, with support for mock functions and warnings.

methods.name: trackSessionBrowserTab
methods.description: Tracks a browser tab session with provided attributes.

methods.name: untrackSessionBrowserTab
methods.description: Removes a specific tab from being tracked in a session.
